hits.snippet: The latest funding round reflects growing investor interest in software that supports autonomous AI operations rather than individual AI applications. Instead of creating another chatbot or coding assistant, Naïve provides the underlying systems that allow developers to launch businesses, connect essential services, manage operating resources, and coordinate AI agents from a unified platform.
